items.q: Which arterial vessel joins the capillary plexus at the median eminence to form the hypothalamo-hypophysial portal system?
items.exp: The superior hypophyseal artery joins the median eminence to form the hypothalamo-hypophysial portal system supplying the anterior lobe. (Book p938)

items.q: The sole anterior pituitary hormone maintained under tonic negative hypothalamic inhibition by dopamine is ___.
items.exp: Prolactin is under dominant tonic negative hypothalamic inhibition mediated by prolactin inhibitory factor (PRIF / dopamine). (Book p938)

items.q: Match the hypothalamic releasing factor to its anterior pituitary target — 1) CRH 2) TRH 3) GnRH 4) GHRH … A) Corticotrophs (ACTH) B) Thyrotrophs (TSH) C) Gonadotrophs (FSH/LH) D) Somatotrophs (GH)
items.exp: CRH, TRH, GnRH, and GHRH exert stimulatory influence over corticotrophs, thyrotrophs, gonadotrophs, and somatotrophs respectively. (Book p938)

items.q: A neuroscientist traces the synthesis of antidiuretic hormone. Magnocellular neurons in which hypothalamic nuclei produce pro-vasopressin?
items.exp: Magnocellular neurons within the supraoptic and paraventricular nuclei produce pro-vasopressin. (Book p938)

items.q: Which molecule is NOT a cleavage product of pro-vasopressin transported down the pituitary stalk?
items.exp: Pro-vasopressin cleaves into ADH, neurophysin, and copeptin; oxytocin is a distinct nonapeptide synthesized separately. (Book p938)

items.q: Assess the vascular supply of the pituitary gland: I The anterior lobe receives regulatory hormones through long portal vessels derived from the superior hypophyseal artery. II The posterior lobe receives direct arterial branches from the inferior hypophyseal artery.
opts: Both I and II are true
Both I and II are false
items.exp: The anterior lobe receives portal blood via the superior hypophyseal artery, whereas the posterior pituitary is supplied directly by the inferior hypophyseal artery. (Book p938)

items.q: A 54-year-old woman with metastatic breast adenocarcinoma develops acute central diabetes insipidus. Metastatic emboli reached her posterior pituitary directly through which vessel?
items.exp: Breast carcinoma metastases can directly seed the posterior pituitary gland via the inferior hypophyseal artery. (Book p938)

items.q: Oxytocin is synthesized within hypothalamic magnocellular neurons and stored within the:
items.exp: Oxytocin is synthesized in the hypothalamus and stored in the posterior pituitary. (Book p938)

items.q: Dopamine reaches the anterior pituitary lactotrophs via the ___ pathway to suppress prolactin secretion.
items.exp: Dopamine acts as prolactin inhibitory factor via the tubero-infundibular pathway. (Book p938)

items.q: Match the pituitary lobe to its primary vascular route — 1) Anterior pituitary 2) Posterior pituitary … A) Hypothalamo-hypophysial portal system (Superior hypophyseal artery) B) Direct systemic arterial supply (Inferior hypophyseal artery)
items.exp: The anterior pituitary is supplied by the portal system from the superior hypophyseal artery, while the posterior lobe receives direct systemic blood via the inferior hypophyseal artery. (Book p938)

items.q: Assess the hypothalamic control of anterior pituitary secretion: I Somatostatin exerts an inhibitory influence on growth hormone release. II Prolactin secretion increases when the pituitary stalk is sectioned.
opts: Both I and II are true
Both I and II are false
items.exp: Somatostatin inhibits GH secretion; sectioning the stalk interrupts dopamine delivery, causing prolactin hypersecretion. (Book p938)

items.q: Which cleavage marker of pro-vasopressin serves as an equimolar, stable surrogate for ADH release?
items.exp: Copeptin is cleaved from pro-vasopressin alongside ADH and neurophysin. (Book p938)
